headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 6, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners secured a dominant 4-0 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Bryce Miller pitching 6.0 innings of shutout baseball. Dominic Canzone led the Mariners' offense with a 3-hit, 2-RBI performance, including an 8th home run of the season. In other action, the Kansas City Royals took down the Minnesota Twins 3-2, with Carter Jensen leading the Royals' offense with a home run and two RBIs. The St. Louis Cardinals outlasted the Cincinnati Reds 6-5 in a closely contested matchup.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with the Los Angeles Angels placing right-handed pitcher Jack Kochanowicz on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Milwaukee Brewers, Los Angeles Dodgers, New York Yankees, Los Angeles Angels, and Texas Rangers.

The Chicago Cubs made a trade, acquiring left-handed pitcher Antoine Kelly from the Los Angeles Dodgers. The Milwaukee Brewers also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Joel Kuhnel from the Athletics for cash. Other trades include the Boston Red Sox acquiring left-handed pitcher Joe La Sorsa from the Pittsburgh Pirates, the Cincinnati Reds trading right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash, and the Los Angeles Angels trading catcher Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Twins in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals took down the Minnesota Twins 3-2, securing a crucial win. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Edge Reds in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals outlasted the Cincinnati Reds 6-5 in a closely contested matchup. Matt McLain led the Reds with a home run and two RBIs, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Cardinals' late-game surge.

top_news.title: **Giants Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs edged the San Francisco Giants 3-2 in a close matchup. Pete Crow-Armstrong led the Cubs' offense with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Angels' Jack Kochanowicz Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels right-handed pitcher Jack Kochanowicz has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Kelly Heads to Wrigley**
top_news.summary: Antoine Kelly, a left-handed pitcher, has been traded to the Chicago Cubs. The Los Angeles Dodgers dealt Kelly to the Cubs in a trade.
